title: Galatasaray Faces Kocaelispor in Clash for the Süper Lig Lead
seoTitle: Galatasaray vs Kocaelispor: Süper Lig Clash
subtitle: Sunday's match promises to shake up the table following the champions' victory and the visitors' strong run
excerpt: Galatasaray host Kocaelispor at RAMS Park aiming to keep the Süper Lig lead, while Selçuk İnan's side seek to climb the table with a fifth win.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
After losing 3-1 to Sporting CP in the Champions League, Galatasaray turn their focus back to the domestic league. The clash against Kocaelispor, scheduled for Sunday, September 13, at 8:00 PM (Turkish time), could determine whether the champions retain first place.

Galatasaray seek to maintain the lead

Manager Okan Buruk guided the team to three wins and one draw across the first four games of the season, tallying ten points. The team boasts the best offensive defense, with twelve goals scored, and has not lost at home since May 2024. The 3-2 victory over Başakşehir bolstered the squad's confidence, which now needs to bounce back quickly from the European defeat.

Kocaelispor attempt to climb the table

Coached by Selçuk İnan, Kocaelispor surprised by collecting nine points in four rounds, sitting in third place, just one point behind Galatasaray. After losing the opening fixture against Başakşehir, the team responded with three consecutive victories: 2-0 over Amedspor, 2-1 over Konyaspor, and 1-0 over Samsunspor.

Absences that could influence the clash

Galatasaray head into the matchup without Victor Osimhen, Mario Lemina, Wilfried Singo, and Günay Güvenç, who are unavailable due to fitness issues. Even with these absences, the team still has the advantage of playing at home at RAMS Park, where they have been difficult to beat.

Recent head-to-head record

Last season, Kocaelispor defeated Galatasaray 1-0 in November 2025 and drew 1-1 at RAMS Park in April. These results show that the visitors are capable of pulling off a surprise, especially after an above-average start to their campaign.

What is at stake

For Galatasaray, maintaining their ten-point tally is essential to protect the lead and regain momentum after the continental defeat. Kocaelispor, on the other hand, view the match as an opportunity to leapfrog the champions and consolidate their place among the front-runners. The clash brings together two of the best-performing sides so far and promises to be decisive for the first half of the season.

With information from beIN SPORTS, ge, Terra.
